answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a violet-tagged bond on a public ledge before earning reputation, and honest peers form a haven that slashes bonds of duplicate identities. An attacker must fund every fake identity with real capital, risking total loss on detection, so forging N sybils costs N times the bond plus slashing penalties, making mass identity fraud economically irrational.
